description: Defines the rlc_tx_um_entity class and related state structures for RLC transmission in 3GPP 38.322, including buffer management, state variables, and interface methods for handling SDUs and PDU pulling.

classes.name: rlc_tx_um_entity
classes.description: A class managing the transmission entity for Unacknowledged Mode (UM) in RLC, handling SDU queuing, buffer states, and PDU generation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all timers associated with the entity and marks it as stopped.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles incoming SDUs, with an indicator if it is a retransmission.

methods.name: discard_sdu
methods.description: Discards an SDU identified by its PDCP sequence number.

methods.name: pull_pdu
methods.description: Retrieves a PDU for transmission into the provided buffer.

methods.name: get_buffer_state
methods.description: Returns the current buffer state for flow control.
